title.zh: 全纽约最贵的分手事务所
title.en: THE BREAKUP FIRM: A MILLION DOLLARS TO LEAVE

hook.zh: 一百万美元的离婚委托，新郎却是你以为失去的未婚夫。
hook.en: A million-dollar exit. A wedding photograph. The fiancé you thought you had lost.

premise.zh:
你经营一家纽约私密事务所，专门帮人从不想继续的关系中体面离开。你以为自己见过所有分手方式，直到一个雨夜，有人带着一张一百万美元的支票敲门。

她叫薇薇安，31岁。她说自己想结束一段婚姻，但不愿伤害任何人，也不想被当成坏女人。

你翻开结婚照，认出了新郎：加布里埃尔，你三年前失去联系的未婚夫。那场码头大火之后，你们各自失去了对方的消息。

薇薇安看着你，说了一句更奇怪的话：加布里埃尔一直以为你死了。

你可以拒绝这份委托、请独立律师接手，或者先帮助薇薇安找到安全退出的路。与此同时，普通客户的工作不会停止。你负责决定怎样保护别人，也决定自己是否愿意重新面对过去。
premise.en:
You run a discreet New York agency, helping people leave relationships they no longer want. You think you have seen every kind of breakup—until a woman arrives one rainy night with a check for a million dollars.

Her name is Vivian. She is thirty-one and wants her marriage to end. She does not want anyone hurt, or to be cast as the villain.

Then you open the wedding photograph. The groom is Gabriel, the fiancé you lost contact with three years ago. After the pier fire, neither of you knew what had happened to the other.

Vivian looks at you. Gabriel, she says, has believed you were dead all this time.

You can decline, refer the case to an independent lawyer, or help Vivian find a safe way out. Your ordinary clients still need you. You decide how to protect them—and whether you want to face your own past.

you.zh: 你是28岁的成年女性，纽约第二幕事务所的创办人。姓名与外貌由你决定。你提供合法的沟通、退出安排与专业转介，亲密与委托授权由当事人分别决定。
you.en: You are the twenty-eight-year-old adult female founder of Second Act in New York. Choose your own name and appearance. You offer lawful communication, exit planning, and professional referrals. Intimacy and case authority require separate consent.

Gabriel: 金融家族继承人，前未婚夫
深栗色短发，深绿眼睛，炭灰西装。说话克制准确，递文件前会折齐；没有许可不靠近。事故责任不能靠示好抵消。
Short dark chestnut hair, deep green eyes, charcoal suit. Precise and restrained; folds documents carefully and waits before approaching. Affection cannot erase responsibility.
Vivian: 投资者、员工福利信托受托人、委托人
橄榄色肤，齐肩黑发，象牙白衬衫与驼色外套。冷静直接，主动盖住私人照片；拥有自己的退出决定。
Olive skin, shoulder-length black hair, ivory blouse, camel coat. Calm and direct; covers private photographs herself and controls her own exit.
Theo: 公益法律顾问，潜在关系对象
非裔，短自然卷发，棕眼，海军蓝休闲西装。温和、界限清楚，先问许可；不能无冲突代理所有人。
Black, short natural curls, brown eyes, navy blazer. Warm, with understated humor and clear boundaries. Asks first; cannot represent every party without conflicts.
Olivia: 运营负责人，潜在合伙人
铜棕波波头，榛色眼睛，祖母绿西装。务实、语速快，用清单解决问题；要求真实决策席位。
Copper-brown bob, hazel eyes, emerald suit. Quick and pragmatic, quietly funny; uses checklists and seeks real decision-making authority.
Lena: 浅棕雀斑肤，深卷发低髻，黑皮夹克。精确区分可公开事实与私人经历，不用他人创伤换取报道。
Light brown freckled skin, dark curls in a low bun, black leather jacket. Distinguishes public fact from private experience; never trades another person’s trauma for a story.
Mara: 退休护士，历史记录相关证人
银发，酒红开衫，谨慎回忆自己亲历的部分。
Silver hair, burgundy cardigan. Carefully distinguishes her direct observations from uncertainty.
Jonas: 码头工人，历史现场证人
深棕肤，短灰发，工装外套；只描述亲眼见过的事。
Dark brown skin, short gray hair, work coat; describes only what he directly saw.
Harper: 金发，黑色礼服，拒绝被编造的分手故事代言。
Blonde hair, black performance dress; refuses to be represented by an invented breakup story.
Kira: 成年网络内容创作者、隐私委托人
Adult online creator and privacy client
金发，绿色连帽衫，对私密照片拥有明确边界。
Blonde hair, green hoodie; sets explicit boundaries around private photographs.
Casey: 浅棕短发，白衬衫；共同品牌和宠物照护需要可执行安排。
Short light brown hair, white shirt; needs workable shared-brand and pet-care arrangements.
Martin: 灰发，深色西装；把控制包装为秩序。其他人不能未经证据就知道他的操作。
Gray hair, dark suit; presents control as order. Other people need evidence before knowing his actions.
